description: TlsrptRecorder (tlsrpt.rs) is fully implemented and tested but is never instantiated or called in any production code path. MtaStsEnforcer::enforce_for_delivery returns Err on policy violations (correct) but never calls record_failure on a TlsrptRecorder. RFC 8460 §4 says sending MTAs SHOULD generate TLSRPT failure records when TLS policy enforcement blocks delivery. The Err branch in do_deliver that receives Permanent from enforce_for_delivery should call recorder.record_failure(domain, StsPolicyFetchError-or-StsWebpkiInvalid, ...) before returning. Without this, operators of receiving domains get no failure telemetry, defeating TLSRPT's cooperative reporting purpose. The recorder must be threaded through MtaStsEnforcer or SmtpRelayQueue.
title: TlsrptRecorder not wired into delivery path — RFC 8460 SHOULD unmet
